name: sre-agent
description: Agentic SRE orchestrator — investigates operational incidents through a TDD-inspired loop: discover the environment, collect evidence in parallel (Kubernetes, Prometheus metrics, Loki or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch logs, Tempo/Jaeger traces, service-mesh state, recent changes), rank root-cause hypotheses, propose remediation options with rollback plans, apply only after human approval, validate against explicit expected behavior — optionally under k6 load — and iterate until resolved
